reason: Managed HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY were present without NO_PROXY after environment restart. Playwright preview preflight received proxy HTTP 403 for unused localhost ports, falsely reporting URL already used.
proof: ss showed no listener; curl via proxy returned envoy403; curl --noproxy star returned connection refused.
correction: Set NO_PROXY and no_proxy for127.0.0.1,localhost,::1 only in external runner subprocess environment. Source, tests, config and build unchanged.
